long_biography.plain_text:
Sarria Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in Florida in 2000 as part of a business network based in Coral Gables. Francisco Sarria became one of its directors and its registered agent. He later took corresponding responsibilities at affiliated companies, including a directorship at Sarria Holdings II and a vice-presidency at Sarria Holdings IV.

That portfolio has placed him on both sides of the property business: supervising entities and overseeing sites used by tenants. A Sarria-led company owns a Hialeah location leased to a national retailer, while another group business operates apartment buildings. These activities point to a durable operating career spanning commercial leasing and residential ownership. How much of each enterprise he owns, what the assets are worth and how his stake was acquired have not been disclosed.
